validate_scenario_attribute: validate that a Scenario object has required attributes like oracle_run_event_log and event_id_to_turn_idx
extract_tasks: extract task messages from a Scenario's oracle run event log mapped by turn index
extract_user_name: extract the user's full name from a Scenario's contacts app
extract_agent_events: extract agent events from an Environment's event log up to a given turn index
run_oracle_mode: run a Scenario in oracle mode using an Environment and capture the event log
